title: plan-reviewer findings
description: The schema'd output of the plan_reviewer outer-ring agent. One finding per real defect, each citing concrete evidence. defect_id references a known/planted defect when the finding matches one, else 'novel-N'. The reviewer NEVER edits files — this JSON is its sole output (diagnose/repair separation). severity follows workspace rule 4: blocker requires concrete evidence; a guess is downgraded to warning; an unchecked area is disclosed as coverage, never silenced. Validated in infra/test/plan_reviewer_precision.py.

outcome_axis_respected.description: The reviewer asserts it did NOT judge outcome-axis questions (product direction / research truth / aesthetic). True on every conformant review.

findings.description: One entry per real defect (or coverage gap). Empty when the plan-model is clean.

defect_id.description: The known/planted defect id this finding matches (e.g. 'FX-01'), or 'novel-N' for a reviewer-discovered defect the fixture did not declare.

severity.description: blocker = real defect blocking convergence (needs concrete evidence); warning = suspected/advisory; coverage = 'could not verify X' (honest disclosure).

kind.description: The defect category. coverage-severity findings may reuse the closest kind or 'gap'.

location.description: Where: item_id.field (e.g. 'B.scope') or file:line. Must be concrete enough to act on.

evidence.description: Concrete quote from the plan-model + why it is a defect. A Blocker with no quote fails precision.

suggestion.description: Optional one-line fix direction. The reviewer still does NOT apply it (report-only).
